auth.description:
Provide your Leap AI API key. 

**How to get your API key:**
1. Go to [app.tryleap.ai](https://app.tryleap.ai)
2. Click on **Settings** in the left sidebar (bottom)
3. Navigate to the **API** section
4. Click **Create API Key** to generate a new key
5. Copy and paste the key here

getAWorkflowRun.name: getAWorkflowRun
getAWorkflowRun.description: Retrieve the status and results of a workflow run

workflow_run_id.description: The ID of the workflow run to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the current status and results of a single Leap AI workflow run by its run ID. Use to poll a run started by "Run a Workflow" until it completes. Requires the workflow run ID. Read-only and safe to call repeatedly.

runAWorkflow.name: runAWorkflow
runAWorkflow.description: Execute a Leap AI workflow and return the run ID

workflow_id.description: The ID of the workflow to run

webhook_url.description: The URL to which workflow results should be sent on completion (optional)

input.description: Variables that the workflow can use globally and their values (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Starts execution of a Leap AI workflow identified by its workflow ID, optionally passing input variables and a webhook URL to receive results on completion. Returns a run ID to track progress; pair with "Get a Workflow Run" to poll for status and results. Each call launches a new run, so it is not idempotent.

nl.Automate any workflow with AI. Build cus: Automatiseer elke workflow met AI. Bouw aangepaste AI-automatiseringen om uw marketing, verkoop en operaties te schalen.
nl.Provide your Leap AI API key. \n\n**How:
Geef je Leap AI API-sleutel aan. 

**Hoe je je API-sleutel verkrijgt:**
1. Ga naar [app.tryleap.ai](https://app.tryleap.ai)
2. Klik op **Instellingen** in de linker zijbalk (onder)
3. Navigeer naar de **API** sectie
4. Klik **Maak API Key** om een nieuwe sleutel te genereren
5. Kopieer en plak de sleutel hier

fr.Provide your Leap AI API key. \n\n**How:
Fournissez votre clé d'API Leap AI. 

**Comment obtenir votre clé API :**
1. Allez sur [app.tryleap.ai](https://app.tryleap.ai)
2. Cliquez sur **Paramètres** dans la barre latérale gauche (en bas)

4. Cliquez sur **Créer une clé API** pour générer une nouvelle clé
5. Copiez et collez la clé ici
